Under Typhoon Chiangpi, for 10/23 14–20 h local seven of eight models say High, with a 76% chance of gusts over 49 kt; the German model shows gusts of 60.1 kt and the US model 50.2 kt. For 10/23 20 h to 10/24 02 h local all eight models say High, with the European model showing a 34.9 kt crosswind. The current airport forecast (TAF) has gusts of 45 kt and a land typhoon warning is in effect. Disruption risk is High, easing to Low from 10/25.
